[ASSISTANT_SAID] Forums support skill development by enabling users to ask and answer questions, share knowledge, and engage in discussions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Social media groups provide a space for users to share resources, ask questions, and receive feedback, as well as networking opportunities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specialized websites offer courses, tutorials, and educational resources, including interactive exercises and assessments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The type of online community best for skill development depends on the user's goals and interests.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Skillshare - Offers video courses on creative topics and business skills.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Udemy - Offers a wide range of courses created by industry experts, available for free or paid.  
[USER] User asked for recommendations for websites that offer resources for learning a new language.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Babbel - Offers courses in 14 languages focusing on grammar, vocabulary, and conversation skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Rosetta Stone - Known for its immersive method, offers courses in 25 languages.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Memrise - Offers courses in over 20 languages with a gamified approach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Busuu - Offers interactive courses in 12 languages and a language exchange feature.
